description:
gf2-sim permanent-campaign validation pins the frozen validation journal, receipt, continuation authorization and producer-0 preregistration to paths under `dev/active/02b8137c/`. It locates them through one runtime-resolved repository root and identifies them by digest.

## Background

Readers: `crates/gf2-sim/src/permanent_campaign/validation.rs:68-74,1359-1367` and `crates/gf2-sim/tests/permanent_validation.rs`. The worker on the in-progress pre-draw validation task (02b8137c) also edits `validation.rs`; this change is coordinated with that worker.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Validation locates the frozen evidence through one repository root resolved at runtime, and identity checks compare digests rather than recorded path strings; every digest check, including the authorized legacy preregistration digest, is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: Before the change, a linked baseline record lists the validation verdict for every committed frozen-evidence bundle and snapshot copy, with the exact command and commit; after the change, the same run yields identical verdicts, so existing evidence stays valid.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test validates evidence located away from its original directory.
- [hard] REQ-04: No historical-path allow-list or hard-coded `dev/` path remains in the changed consumer; code review checks the change against `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`.
- [hard] REQ-05: The Rust CI gate passes.
title: Identify frozen campaign evidence by content in gf2-sim validation
